description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is seeking a experienced MBA graduate with a consistent record of developing and instituting practices and methods that achieve operational efficiency across a global field organization. The ideal candidate will have: broad familiarity with modern B2B business administration methods and tools; experience in Enterprise business development; international know-how and comfort in taking care of diverse cultures proven mastery; knowledge of various industries

What you’ll be doing:

  • Support leadership with a variety of strategic projects

  • Lead the team analysts 

  • Work with industry leaders on the development of the relevant sales strategies

  • Define and build a framework that links and unifies planning, implementation and monitoring activities across worldwide field marketing.

  • Support regional team and leadership in development and execution of core sales strategies

  • Work seamlessly and effectively across Enterprise Marketing, Sales Operations and Finance teams to develop highly aligned and effective cross-organizational processes, reporting, and feedback/input mechanisms.

What we need to see:

  • MBA graduate

  • 8+ years of professional experience, ideally within a global B2B Enterprise and/or consulting.

  • A track record demonstrating proficiency in operational methods - planning, implementation and monitoring.

  • High level of energy and situational adaptability.

  • Consistent record to effectively work in matrix organisations and present informal leadership.

  • Shown ability to interact optimally across groups, and to work effectively with executives.

  • Outstanding written, verbal and presentation skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Proficiency in two or more languages.

  • Experience in a variety of industries.

  • Experience in product management and demand creation.

  • Experience in chief of staff and/or strategy and operations roles

If you're ready to take on this outstanding opportunity and help NVIDIA continue to lead the world in technology innovation, apply now!
